newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Eletropaulo to issue debentures.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Eletropaulo to issue debentures.

text.p: Sao Paulo state owned power utility Eletropaulo will issue 332 million reais ($317.5 million) in debentures on Monday, a company official said.
Henrique Singermann, Eletropaulo's financial director, told Reuters the debentures will be used to pay off part of the company's debt to Sao Paulo state owned power generator and distributor Cesp.
The debentures are part of a deal reached with Cesp last September under which Eletropaulo agreed to pay all of its 515 million reais debt to the power generator, Singermann said.
Under the deal, Cesp will acquire all the 5,000 debentures totalling 332 million reais. Since September, the remaining 213 million reais has been paid in monthly installments to Cesp, he said.

The face value of each debenture will be 66,400 reais and the debentures will be divided in five series. The first series will mature on April 24, 1998 and the second series on October 24 1998, he said. The third and fourth series will due on April 24, 1999 and Oct 24, 1999, respectively, he said. The last series will mature on April 4, 2000, he added.
It will pay yields of 1.6 percent annually plus the variation of ANBID interest rate, which is measured by Brazil's Association of Investment Banks, he said.
Eletropaulo has debts totalling 2.7 billion reais and it is expected to be privatized in the first half next year, he said.
